method: One subagent examined every query against all 16 fixture source texts; deterministic assertions check quote, scope, generator equality and input preservation. No runtime LLM judge was called; no live user data was read.
limitations: Agent review is not human review and cannot satisfy a gate explicitly requiring a human.
A review of synthetic Gold validates labels, not model answer accuracy or production generalization.
No physical extraction/PDF layout audit, live retrieval rerun or 100-answer judge run was performed here.
The corpus has no genuine same-time same-instance owner conflict, little fragmentation and only four repeated operational templates.
Alias clarification tolerance is documented but existing answer metrics do not execute this nuanced rubric.
